entities.name: Stanisław Kostanecki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanisław Kostanecki was a Polish organic chemist, professor who pioneered in vegetable dye chemistry e.g. curcumin. He is best known for discovering Kostanecki acylation, which was named after him.
